facts.text: I like that Wingman by Clari provides recordings and call feedback immediately after the call.
I use Wingman by Clari to look back and ensure I covered all actionable commitments made during the conversation.
Wingman by Clari helps me be present during the call without being distracted by notetaking.
I dislike that there is a learning curve to using the full features of Wingman by Clari.
I specifically find the battlecards and prompts around speaking mid-call part of the learning curve.
I like that Wingman by Clari helps with notetaking during calls.
I use Wingman by Clari to share model demos and best practices with colleagues.
I use Wingman by Clari to make sure actionable requests from prospects are addressed following the call.
I like that Wingman by Clari lets me send clips and comments directly to team members via Slack.
I like creating Game Tapes in Wingman by Clari by highlighting a particular part of the transcript.
I like that Game Tapes creation avoids trimming the timeline or using a screen recorder to replay a moment.
I like the comment feature in Wingman by Clari.
I like that the comment feature includes project management and collaboration features.
I have used Wingman by Clari for about 2 months.
Wingman by Clari has blown away the previous Call Intelligence tool I used.
I dislike that I have a learning curve for full features, but it is worth investing time in.
I like that Wingman by Clari makes reviewing and recording calls more reliable and streamlined.
I am a sales consulting company.
I need the ability to provide specific training to clients.
I need to gather insights into how clients are performing on their sales calls.
Wingman by Clari gives me exactly what I need for training and performance insights.
I like that Wingman by Clari makes it easy to learn more about my position by listening to client calls that already happened.
I prefer listening to past client calls instead of waiting to sit in on upcoming calls.
I have no dislikes yet about Wingman by Clari.
I do not foresee my opinion changing about Wingman by Clari.
